units.source_text: “噢，我也得去跟客人打个招呼。”

en.t: "Oh, I should go and greet the guests too."

units.source_text: 龙助说罢，走到女人们那边，跟她们讲了些什么。

en.t: After saying this, Ryusuke walked over to the women and said something to them.

units.source_text: 女人们一齐把目光投向千重子。

en.t: The women all turned their eyes toward Chieko at once.

units.source_text: 千重子脸上顿时飞起一片红潮。

en.t: A flush instantly rose across Chieko's face.
